finding.title: The `name` field in the `Record` structure is defined as `char name[15];`, but there is no check to ensure that the input does not exceed this size.
The `chunk` structure in the `main` function is declared but not initialized.
There is no validation for the `recordsInChunk` field, which could lead to out-of-bounds access if it exceeds the number of records actually present.

findings.description: The `name` field in the `Record` structure is defined as `char name[15];`, but there is no check to ensure that the input does not exceed this size.
The `chunk` structure in the `main` function is declared but not initialized.
There is no validation for the `recordsInChunk` field, which could lead to out-of-bounds access if it exceeds the number of records actually present.
